selected-colors.title: ble, nwa, wouj
selected-colors.bodyMarkdown:
Start with three useful colors:

- **ble** — blue
- **nwa** — black
- **wouj** — red

Now use one of them in a complete description: **Syèl la ble.** — The sky is blue.

You also saw **ansyen kay wouj la** — the old red house.

selected-size.title: piti
selected-size.bodyMarkdown:
Use **piti** for “small.” Compare it in two complete descriptions:

- **Otèl la piti anpil.** — The hotel is very small.
- **Tab la piti.** — The table is small.

Practice these complete sentences before making new combinations.

selected-qualities.title: bon, pwòp, trankil
selected-qualities.bodyMarkdown:
Practice three useful qualities:

- **bon** — good
- **pwòp** — clean
- **trankil** — quiet

Use **bon** in the complete phrase **Se yon bon timoun.** — It's a good child.

**Se** is already known; the new vocabulary focus here is **bon**.
